title.zh: 持久记忆生命周期成为完整评测对象
title.en: Persistent-memory lifecycle becomes a complete evaluation object

delta.zh: 评测从正确召回扩展到恶意写入、后续检索与生成、防御 utility、权限和反复压缩后的规则保持。
delta.en: Evaluation expands from correct recall to malicious writes, later retrieval and generation, defense utility, authority, and rule survival after repeated compaction.

consequence.zh: Memory 方法需要同时报告一般能力、治理和生命周期完整性。
consequence.en: Memory methods now need to report general capability, governance, and lifecycle integrity together.

title.zh: 语料成为可训练、可版本化的状态
title.en: The corpus becomes trainable, versioned state

delta.zh: KBGym、Snapshot Compatibility Audit 与 RAG Collapse 将知识库编辑、快照变化和自生成内容反馈纳入评测。
delta.en: KBGym, Snapshot Compatibility Audit, and RAG Collapse bring knowledge-store editing, snapshot change, and self-authored feedback into evaluation.

consequence.zh: RAG 可靠性需要绑定语料版本、写入行为和反馈路径。
consequence.en: RAG reliability now needs to bind claims to corpus versions, write behavior, and feedback paths.

title.zh: Data Agent 进入可归因的研究改进
title.en: Data agents move into attributable research improvement

delta.zh: AI4AI-Bench 与 DeltaML-Bench 把真实训练仓库、基线改进、clean-start 运行和 anti-gaming audit 放入同一协议。
delta.en: AI4AI-Bench and DeltaML-Bench combine real training repositories, baseline improvement, clean-start runs, and anti-gaming audits.

consequence.zh: 研究 Agent 的分数需要与代码变化、实验轨迹和最终复现共同解释。
consequence.en: Research-agent scores now need joint interpretation with code changes, experiment trajectories, and final reproduction.
